_about: Simple EJ's bar recipe cards, transcribed from Will's photos of the laminated cards behind the bar (10/13/26). A head start for the bar module; Back Office's recipes are the source of truth once exported, and any difference between the two is a finding. Amounts are exactly as printed; 'splash' and 'top' have no volume on the card. rpower_item is the RPOWER button, with its sales from the local ticket archive 8/25/26-10/12/26.
source: photos of the bar's recipe cards

recipes.name: Old Fashioned - Classic
recipes.method: Stir in a stirring glass for 20 seconds; strain over a large cube.
recipes.garnish: orange peel ('glammed' on the card) and a Filthy cherry
flags: WhistlePig is best known for rye - confirm the exact bottle (Back Office item).

recipes.name: Smoked Walnut Maple Old Fashioned

rpower_also.note: likely a double batch - confirm the spec

recipes.method: Stir in a stirring glass for 20 seconds; strain over a large ice cube.
recipes.garnish: expressed orange peel and a toasted walnut
flags: The name says smoked but the build has no smoke step - confirm whether it's smoked (and what that costs).

recipes.name: Pure Passion Margarita
recipes.method: Rim a rocks glass with Tajin. Build in a shaker tin with the lime juice first; strain over fresh ice.
flags: Passion fruit: puree or syrup? (product and cost differ).

recipes.name: Sweet Mango
recipes.method: Muddle simple syrup and mint in a shaker; add the rest (juice first); shake and strain into a tall glass; top with soda.
recipes.garnish: mint and a dehydrated lime wheel
flags: Matched to the RPOWER button 'Mango Mojito' (rum, mint, lime, mango, soda) - confirm it's the same drink.

recipes.name: Espresso Martini
recipes.method: Shaker, simple syrup first; shake hard for foam; double strain.
flags: Coffee liqueur brand not named on the card.

recipes.name: All Girls Deserve Flowers
recipes.method: Shake everything but the soda; strain into a tall glass with ice; top with soda water.
flags: Gin and elderflower liqueur brands not named on the card.

recipes.name: Dirty Martini
recipes.rpower_note: No Dirty Martini button: it's rung as a vodka with the 'Martini' liquor add-on (126 Martini add-ons since 8/25, dirty or not can't be told apart).
recipes.method: Shaker with olive brine first; shake until frosted; strain.
flags: Vodka is whichever the guest calls (the spirit button rung with it).

recipes.name: Spa Water
recipes.method: Build in a glass with ice; stir gently.
flags: Ginger syrup is a house recipe - its own batch recipe is needed to cost it.

recipes.name: Charlie's Sipper
recipes.method: Build in a glass with ice; stir gently.
flags: Soda water and lemon-lime soda have no amounts on the card.
